test_title: PYST 42: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the numbers in the following sets.

(Note: Operations must be performed on whole numbers, without breaking the numbers into their component digits. Take 13 for example - operations on 13 such as addition/subtraction/multiplication etc. can be performed only on 13. Breaking 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(8, 26, 48)

(10, 28, 50)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(2nd No. − 1st No.) = 18 and (3rd No. − 2nd No.) = 22

(8, 26, 48) → 26 − 8 = 18 and 48 − 26 = 22

(10, 28, 50) → 28 − 10 = 18 and 50 − 28 = 22
